clinical_note: 72-year-old male with septic shock on norepinephrine vasopressor support. Intubated and mechanically ventilated at FiO2 0.8. SpO2 critically low despite ventilator. Creatinine critically elevated at 3.2 mg/dL with oliguria less than 0.3 mL/kg/h. History of COPD and chronic kidney disease. Vasopressor requirement increasing. Broad-spectrum antibiotics initiated. Blood cultures pending. Hemodynamic instability worsening.
